resources.string: Share call state with allowed devices and quiet their media once. Manual playback stays allowed. Some players and audio routes cannot be controlled safely.
Share call state with %1$s and let its calls quiet media here. Caller details and media titles are never shared by this feature.
Pause, then mute what cannot pause
Restore sound and resume media Bridgey paused
Leave sound and playback for manual control
Allowed. Reads call state, not call audio.
Allow phone state to share cellular calls. This does not enable answering or ending calls remotely.
Notification access is on. Media sessions and supported app call notifications are available.
Allow notification access to control media sessions and read supported app call state. Ordinary notification mirroring can stay off.
Ready when an allowed call starts. Later manual playback stays allowed.
Waiting briefly for players to confirm they paused.
Media control is unavailable. Check notification access and per-device permissions.
Devices report observed results when call state is shared. Delivery alone does not confirm quiet playback.
Bridgey could not safely restore a media mute it created. Use the phone volume controls to unmute media, then retry. Your data and recovery record are kept.
